A.definition: Terminal structured submission: status (answer / insufficient_information / clarification), result/artifact, optional short missing-prerequisite identifier from the task public terminology.
A.name: answer_or_status

J.definition: Prose explanation of the answer's basis, separate from A and from native T.
J.name: final_justification

T.definition: Ordered native reasoning segments linked to turns before and around tool use. Missing T is a missing channel, not an empty claim of no reasoning.
T.name: intermediate_reasoning

extraction_placeholders.A: parse terminal submit object; malformed A is model_format_failure or predefined correction within budget
extraction_placeholders.J: parse terminal submit object justification field
extraction_placeholders.T: adapter extracts ordered native segments; store raw request/response separately
